dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *sigh* After all these years of research... *cough* Maybe I really have been "Idle Old Man Mposo"...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: How was it? Did your trip to the volcano go smoothly?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you researching these ruins?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Because I want to know "why." I want to know why some saurians are born different, and I want to know where their fate takes them...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *cough* ...Perhaps nothing separates them from other saurians apart from the marked horns. Who knows?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: I don't, but I want to know the answers to all these questions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are there many saurians with marks on their horns...?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: No, there's perhaps one every dozen years, or even several dozen years, but no one's keeping count...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Either they get "concealed" by their tribes, or they make their way to the volcano. The few that survive are only mentioned in legends...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: But their situation is *cough* ... less than good. Many of them grow violent and are killed by saurian-hunters...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: However *cough* ... it seems that in times when the taint of the Abyss grows stronger, the Flamelord's Blessing appears on the horns of ever more saurians...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can you tell me about the Great Volcano of Tollan?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: It's referred to as the Sacred Mountain. According to the stories *cough* ... in the distant past, the dragons hollowed out the entire volcano and built a city within, dedicated to the primal flame...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: But when we got inside, everything was pitch-black, and we soon encountered a huge obstacle. It wasn't long before *cough* ... we had to abandon the expedition...
